description: Bring the OpenFOAM boundary-condition set into outram-foam. Current outram-foam-basic-lib BoundaryCondition<T> enum (fields/boundary/bc.rs) has only FixedValue, FixedField, ZeroGradient, Symmetry, Empty, Calculated. Because all BCs share ONE central enum consumed by the FV operators, additions cannot be parallelised across agents (shared enum + exhaustive operator match sites) — so this is run as a SEQUENCE of focused agents, not a racing fleet. Cyclic (periodic) topology is tracked separately as op-6w0.4. Waves: (1) patch-field value/gradient family; (2) cyclic [op-6w0.4]; (3) cyclicAMI; (4) solver-layer flow BCs (different layer, parallel-able).
title: outram-foam: OpenFOAM boundary-condition coverage
